question:
**Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.**

TARDY
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'** i.e.** 'Prompt'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **"Tardy"** means late or delayed(धीमा, विलम्बी)
 
• **"Prompt"** means on time or without delay.(तत्पर, शीघ्र)
